propositions: Core must perform exactly five push-first CAS retry cycles followed by exactly one conditional terminal push; earlier success exits without the terminal push.

Strict delivery raises reusable PushDeliveryError with one of eleven stable failure reasons and includes git detail plus unpushed-commit count; best-effort mode (default for all existing callers) returns None and preserves warning behavior.

All pre-existing library, CLI, MCP, importer, and store-write callers must retain best-effort disposition by omitting strict or reaching core with strict=False, inheriting only the corrected five-cycle plus one-terminal-push budget.
Strict failure writes no ticket event, emits no BRIDGE_ALERT, and translates to nonzero exit only at the private Python module adapter boundary.
Push-only contract: push_tickets_branch must perform only destination resolution, push/fetch/merge recovery; dirty-tree staging and committing remain outside.
